snippet.title: BEAT FOR SPEED |  Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
BEAT FOR SPEED is launching on November 3, 2026!!

Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

🏁 WHISHLIST & PLAY on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4430260/Beat_For_Speed/

📅 FULL GAME LAUNCHES NOVEMBER 3, 2026


Music featured in Beat For Speed
Thanks to ‪Lauren Records, Epidemic Sound, and the artists for bringing independent music into Beat For Speed!
